located_point.method: Centre of the bright excavated block identified as the castle on the Sentinel-2 median composite, about 360 m west-south-west of the Wikidata starting point (23.886111, 70.216667). The block lies south of a bright east-west band (the north side of the ceremonial ground) and of a longer bright east-west street, with cultivated ground to the west, the arrangement of castle, ceremonial ground, middle town and fields shown in Bisht 2015 Figs. 2.4 and 6.1.

lines.identification: Bright straight band about 510 m long, 205 m north of the castle's north edge, running from the middle town into the lower town. It matches the east-west street drawn across the middle town and lower town in Bisht 2015, Dholavira Report (preliminary, Jan 2015), Fig. 2.4 'Plan showing the various divisions of city of Dholavira' (PDF page 53), which lies about 210 m north of the castle, and is read as the excavated, cleared street surface.

notes: At 10 m the city walls themselves are not resolved. The imagery lines are the bright excavated east-west street that crosses the middle town into the lower town (510 m), the bright band along the north side of the ceremonial ground (194 m), and the north and east edges of the bright castle block. The castle edges are short and fuzzy (castle-east has sigma 6 degrees) and form their own system. A third candidate, a straight dark line at the field boundary about 160 m west of the castle (theta -2.1, five profiles), was fitted during exploration and excluded because it cannot be told apart from a field edge. All three plans draw the walls between 5 and 10 degrees anticlockwise of their arrows; none states the arrow's meaning. In plan-bisht2015-fig6-1 the middle town's south wall runs along the castle, the bailey and several dimension arrows, and its fit (theta -1.1, a third of its profiles inliers) followed mixed drawn elements, so it was put in its own system. Bisht 2015 Fig. 2.2 (PDF page 51) is the same base map drawn north-up without an arrow; it was used only to identify features. No registration was made: the features located sharply in both imagery and plans (the castle corners) span about 150 m, which would give a rotation error of several degrees. The held Bisht 2015 scan also contains a castle plan (Fig. 6.3) and gate and reservoir plans with compass roses, not measured.
